{{Quote|Hey, we don't serve their kind here.''"<br />"''What?''"<br />"''Your droids. They'll have to wait outside. We don't want them here.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and bartender [[Wuher/Legends|Wuher]], in the [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Mos Eisley Cantina]]|<ref name="SWIV">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
'''Anti-droid sentiment''', also known as '''antidroid prejudice''', the '''antidroid movement''',<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> or '''organicism''',<ref name="TCWnovel">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]]</ref> was the prejudice of [[Species/Legends|organic]] beings against machines, particularly [[Droid/Legends|automatons]], especially those who acquired a greater amount of [[sentience programming]], caused by the lack of [[Memory bank/Legends|memory core]] [[Memory wipe/Legends|wipes]], thus able to understand mistreatment and superiority and, as such, able to override their [[life preservation programming]], or just a sense of superiority via organic vs. machine. Since the use of droids predated the establishment of [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] civilization, anti-droid sentiment had probably existed for millennia.

This hatred also extended toward [[Cyborg/Legends#Prejudice|cyborgs]], as they were seen by some as abominations of nature.<ref name="TNEGTD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|He could snag a million bounties and I'd still hate droids.|[[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]]|<ref name="Files">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref>}}
During the [[Great Droid Revolution]] in [[4015 BBY]], the rogue assassin droid [[HK-01]] started an uprising [[Droid supremacy|against]] the organic "masters" of every droid. This uprising particularly the [[Juggernaut war droid]]s' infamous victory over the elite [[Rocket-Jumper Elite Advance Unit|Republic rocket-jumpers]] heightened anti-droid feelings and dealt a death blow to the budding [[Droid rights/Legends|droid-rights movement]] in that period.<ref name="TNEGTD" />

The use of [[Basilisk war droid/Legends|Basilisk war droids]] and [[Krath war droid/Legends|Krath war droids]] by the [[Mandalorian Crusaders|Mandalorians]] and the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] created an upsurge of anti-droid sentiment among the inhabitants of many worlds affected by the conflict. In [[3946 BBY]], [[G0-T0-Telerath]] nearly bankrupted the Republic through the [[Coruscant Financial Exchange]]. Around the same time, several [[G0-T0 infrastructure planning system|G0-T0]] droids assigned to organize planetary reconstruction efforts in the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Secession of 400100500260026|seceded]] from the Republic. These droids established the independent territory of [[400100500260026]] which was regard as a rogue state by the Republic. [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Tol Cressa]] initiated a [[Liberation of 400100500260026|military campaign to annex the territory]].<ref name="TNEGTD" />

In the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], sentients with an aversion to droids formed anti-droid groups like the [[Organization for Organic Purity]]. They were opposed by pro-droid groups like the moderate [[Coalition of Automaton Rights Activists]] and the more radical [[Mechanical Liberation Front]] who viewed droids as equal to sentients and regarded their position in society as akin to [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]]. Their activities ranged from protest rallies to terrorist attacks on manufacturing plants.<ref name="TNEGTD" />

In [[97 BBY]], a major [[Droid Uprising|droid uprising]] occurred on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] colony world of [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]], leading towards widespread sentiment against automata. As a consequence, Bakurans distrusted the use of droids as servants and installed [[Restraining bolt/Legends|restraining bolts]] on all visiting droids.<ref name="TTAB">''[[The Truce at Bakura]]''</ref>

[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] commented once about droids' ability to think, saying "there would be none of us left," though that came off as more of a comment than an ideal.<ref name="SWIV" /> This ideal most likely was heightened during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] but mostly targeted [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], as they were the footsoldiers of the enemy.<ref name="TNEGTD" />

During the [[Second Great Droid Revolution]] in [[10 BBY/Legends|10 BBY]], the cyborg [[Archa Sabis]] started an unsuccessful [[Archa Sabis's droid army|uprising]] among the droid population of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The Galactic Empire was able to exploit anti-cyborg sentiments.<ref name="TNEGTD" /> In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], [[IG-88A/Legends|IG-88]] led a [[IG-88's Droid Army|Droid Army]] during the [[Droid Revolution]], most likely leading to anti-droid feelings among those affected by the conflict, though due to the covert nature of IG-88's failed plot, few were aware that it had ever happened.<ref name="TIA:IG88">{{StoryCite|story=Therefore I Am: The Tale of IG-88|book=Tales of the Bounty Hunters}}</ref>

Throughout the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] ([[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]&mdash;[[30 ABY/Legends|30 ABY]]), the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] expressed an extreme hatred of droids and all mechanical technology. On many occupied worlds including [[Dubrillion/Legends|Dubrillion]]<ref name="DT2:R">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin]]''</ref> and [[Selvaris]],<ref name="TUF">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref> they destroyed many droids in immolation pits.<ref name="TNEGTD" /> During his tenure as leader of the extremist [[Red Knights of Life]] on [[Rhommamool/Legends|Rhommamool]], the Yuuzhan Vong agent [[Nom Anor]] exploited anti-droid sentiment and organized the destruction of all droids on the colony.<ref name="VP">''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]''</ref>
